name: Français
rules: Keep every placeholder ⟦…⟧ exactly (you may move it within the sentence).
Keep the value of every number. You may write it as in the source (0.05, 1,000) or in French style (0,05 ; 1 000), but not 1,000 for one thousand.
Write every number with the ASCII digits 0-9 exactly as in the source; do not use Latin digits.
Do not translate proper names, method/model/dataset names, units, emails, URLs.
Keep the original level of certainty and the direction of comparisons and negations.
Use the terms in terms.json consistently.
